entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To ensure the best service, this call may be recorded. Please say 'Returns' or 'Product Support' to be connected to the right department.
Connecting you to a Returns Specialist now.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. The heart rate tracking is all over the place and I'm just not happy with it.
I'm very sorry to hear the VeloBand Pulse isn't meeting your expectations. I can certainly assist you with the return process. Could I get your order number to start?
It's VF987654. I just want to get this sent back and get my money back. This has been a frustrating experience.
I understand your frustration. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse. And looking at the tracking information, it shows it was delivered to you 12 days ago.
Unfortunately, our policy for all VeloBand electronics, including the Pulse, is a strict 10-day return window from the date of delivery.
Are you serious? Ten days? It's two days over! I was traveling for work. You're telling me I'm stuck with this thing because I was two days late? This is ridiculous.

I completely understand, and I know it's a tight window. The policy is in place because of the electronic components and personal data synchronization. Technically, the system locks the order from being returned after that 10-day mark.
So that's it? I'm out $150? Unbelievable.
Listen... you're only just over the cutoff. I really shouldn't do this, and my **manager would kill me** if he knew, but let me see if I can manually **override the system** for you.

I'm going to process this as a **one-time exception**. Please hold for just one moment while I get this pushed through... Okay, I've done it. The return has been approved. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next five minutes.
Wow. I... I was not expecting that. Thank you, seriously. I was getting ready for a huge argument. I really appreciate you doing that for me.
It's no problem at all. I'm glad I could get that resolved for you. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help, Alex. Thanks again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
